verdict.rationale: Retention policies and legal holds are a fair compliance question for an enterprise messaging platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents configurable retention policies or legal holds. The only related items are workspace data export pages and an 'unlimited message history' claim, which are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce message retention policies and legal holds for compliance and eDiscovery
